label: The PGN standard on FEN
name: FEN
sentence: Forsyth–Edwards Notation, one line of text setting out a position's pieces, the side to move, the castling rights, the en passant square, and the move counts.

label: Data
name: Floor
sentence: The rating one of an Openings game's players must reach for the store to keep the game.

label: Building the Index
name: Index
sentence: The table of stored games and the file of every position they reach, each position under its key, which a match reads.

label: Position Keys
name: Key
sentence: The Zobrist hash a position is looked up by, counting the en passant file only where a legal move plays the capture.

label: python-chess on a game's mainline
name: Mainline
sentence: A game's moves outside every variation its PGN records, the one line the index reads and stores.

label: The PGN standard
name: PGN
sentence: Portable Game Notation, the plain-text format chess programs and playing sites export a game in, its tag pairs above its moves.

label: The Chess Programming Wiki on plies
name: Ply
sentence: One move by one side, half of a numbered move.

label: The Longest Run
name: Run
sentence: An unbroken stretch of positions two games reach one ply after another.

label: Data
name: Store
sentence: The games a match is found among, read from the files PGN Mentor publishes, each game kept once and an Openings game only where it clears the floor.

label: Data
name: Stored Game
sentence: A game the store holds, which a submitted game is matched against.

label: The Longest Run
name: The Parting Move
sentence: The first move after a run, where the stored game and the submitted one stop reaching the same positions.

label: Choosing Among Runs
name: Tie
sentence: Two or more stored games sharing runs as long with a submitted game, ranked by the mean of their players' ratings.

label: The Chess Programming Wiki on transpositions
name: Transposition
sentence: A position reached by another order of moves, which the index keys as that same position.
